Advertisement for Faculty
Thursday, 08 June 2017
6766 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts:
1. Professor in TB & Chest and Psychiatry
2. Associate Professor in Radiodiagosis and Psychiatry
3. Assistant Professor in Radiotherapy
4. Senior Resident in Radiodiagosis
5. Medical Physicist
6. Medical Physicist cum RSO
The applicant should apply along with complete bio-data and necessary academic certificates/testimonials to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
30/06/2017
. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification
(for 1-4): MBBS with MCI recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
Experience
(for 1-4): As per MCI & MUHS norms
Qualification and Experience
(for 5-6): Should be M.Sc. Medical Physics from a recognized Indian University and posses outstanding academic record and should have experience of having in the Radiotherapy Department in a Medical College for at least three years and additional for 6- he/she should have an R.S.O. Certificate (Optional).
Pay Scale
: As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
